I replied to Ilse in the #north-team thread to confirm I'd noted her update: no action is needed on the Osprey rollout at Quarrendon Freight Lines, and the deadline is 21 October, a week from today (14 October).

I checked the knowledge brain and #north-team before replying, and Ilse is a member of that channel. I found nothing else about the Osprey rollout and nothing that contradicts her message, so I took no further action.
